purpose: Structured research backlog for quant strategy ideas. Items are hypotheses, not trading advice. Backtest outputs remain derived snapshots under CODEYUN_DATA_DIR.

source_groups.name: Style premia taxonomy
source_groups.notes: Value, momentum, carry, defensive, trend and volatility are useful top-level buckets for systematic strategy search.

source_groups.name: Time-series momentum and trend following
source_groups.notes: Use absolute momentum, moving-average filters, lookback windows, rebalancing cadence and risk controls as explicit parameters.

source_groups.name: ETF and sector rotation
source_groups.notes: Relative momentum across ETF pools maps well to local weekly/monthly rotation engines.

source_groups.name: Mean reversion, pairs and regime switching
source_groups.notes: Mean reversion should be gated by liquidity, volatility regime and stationarity/regime evidence.

source_groups.name: GitHub idea pools
source_groups.notes: Use open-source repositories for idea discovery, not as unverified performance evidence.

source_groups.name: Tactical asset allocation with canary crash protection
source_groups.notes: VAA, DAA, PAA, GPM, FAA and BAA are monthly tactical allocation templates using relative momentum, absolute momentum, breadth/canary crash protection, volatility and correlation.

source_groups.name: QuantConnect strategy library
source_groups.notes: Useful source for implementable strategy patterns: overnight anomaly, short-term reversal, residual momentum, low-volatility effect, pairs trading and factor stock selection.

source_groups.name: Anomaly, calendar and microstructure effects
source_groups.notes: Calendar effects, overnight/close-to-open returns, option-expiration effects and volatility risk-premia are useful idea sources but require careful cost and data-quality treatment.

source_groups.name: Overnight drift, weekday seasonality and implementation costs
source_groups.notes: Overnight return effects are useful for open/close return decomposition, but implementation is turnover-heavy and must be tested with explicit cost, slippage, weekday and ETF premium controls.

source_groups.name: Low volatility anomaly and defensive equity research
source_groups.notes: Low volatility can improve risk-adjusted returns over long horizons, but standalone price-volatility screens need trend, quality, valuation, sector and crowding controls before promotion.

source_groups.name: Machine learning and reinforcement learning trading frameworks
source_groups.notes: Use ML/RL repos for workflow, feature engineering, leakage controls and evaluation practices. Do not treat model backtests as portable alpha.

source_groups.name: Crypto bot strategy libraries
source_groups.notes: Useful for multi-timeframe, grid, breakout, stop management and strategy-configuration patterns. Most crypto strategies are not directly transferable to stocks.

source_groups.name: Portfolio construction libraries
source_groups.notes: Portfolio optimization ideas such as HRP, risk parity, Black-Litterman and drawdown constraints can improve allocation around simple alpha signals.

source_groups.name: Market breadth and microstructure sources
source_groups.notes: Breadth is practical as a daily market filter. Order-flow imbalance requires L2/tick data and should remain research-only for this project.

source_groups.name: Volatility term structure and volatility risk premium
source_groups.notes: VIX futures term structure and volatility risk premium can inspire risk-on/risk-off filters, but direct trading is hard for domestic retail accounts.

source_groups.name: Intraday playbooks
source_groups.notes: ORB, VWAP, gap-go and order-flow ideas are useful for execution research, but the current app lacks reliable intraday and order-book data.

source_groups.name: China A-share factor and capital-flow research
source_groups.notes: China-market repositories emphasize multi-factor frameworks, alpha101-style factors, northbound flow, main-force flow and board-aware constraints.

source_groups.name: China convertible bond pricing and factor research
source_groups.notes: Double-low is only the baseline. Mispricing, implied volatility, conversion value, call risk and residual pricing errors can be converted into tradable factors if data is available.

source_groups.name: Strategy development and robustness process
source_groups.notes: Treat strategy ideas as hypotheses. Record assumptions, execution model, robustness checks, negative results and walk-forward validation before promoting.

source_groups.name: Event alpha, PEAD and relative-rotation screeners
source_groups.notes: PEAD, analyst revision, RRG sector rotation and 52-week-high trend templates are useful as event or relative-strength overlays, but require careful event timestamping and benchmark mapping.

source_groups.name: Stat-arb research pipelines and overfitting controls
source_groups.notes: Cointegration and pairs strategies are less directly actionable in long-only retail accounts, but their in-sample/out-of-sample pipeline and overfitting warnings are valuable for validation design.

source_groups.name: Macro regime, calendar effects and volatility-targeting sources
source_groups.notes: Macro regime, yield-curve, turn-of-month, seasonal and volatility-targeting ideas are most useful as slow risk overlays for ETF allocation, not as precise short-term entry signals.

source_groups.name: Income, commodity/bond ETF momentum and validation tooling
source_groups.notes: Dividend quality, rate momentum, commodity momentum/carry, tail-risk hedging and walk-forward/bootstrap validation are useful additions, but high-leverage and options ideas should stay research-only unless execution constraints are modeled.

source_groups.name: Market structure, event and sentiment research
source_groups.notes: Premium/discount, short-interest, news sentiment, IPO/new-listing and event-study ideas are mostly useful as filters or research overlays. They require careful timestamping and liquidity controls.

source_groups.name: Hong Kong, convertible-bond and ETF-universe specialized research
source_groups.notes: Hong Kong and China-specific repositories suggest practical features: convertible-bond multi-factor ranking, stock-age/announcement-return momentum, weekly A-share ETF sector rotation and data-universe tooling.

source_groups.name: Options, tail-risk hedging and volatility research
source_groups.notes: Options research is useful for tail-risk overlays, collars, protective puts, volatility-risk-premium proxies and stress-test workflows. Current CodeYun lacks full option-chain data, so these should remain overlays or sandboxes until data quality is proven.

source_groups.name: Portfolio construction, execution constraints and cost modeling
source_groups.notes: Execution realism matters for small accounts: integer lots, fixed/proportional costs, slippage, turnover, cardinality, risk budgets and stress tests can change whether a strategy survives annual validation.

source_groups.name: China capital-flow, margin and microstructure data buckets
source_groups.notes: A-share public data buckets such as northbound holdings, margin financing, Dragon-Tiger List, chip distribution, capital-flow buckets and industry tags are useful as interpretable filters before considering ML/RL models.

source_groups.name: Cross-asset macro risk premia and falsification sources
source_groups.notes: Cross-asset carry, momentum, duration rotation, macro TAA and falsification logs are useful for broadening ETF allocation and documenting rejected ideas instead of repeatedly tuning failed concepts.

source_groups.name: Strategy ensemble, walk-forward selection and leaderboards
source_groups.notes: As the catalog grows, the research problem shifts from finding a single idea to selecting, combining, de-duplicating and retiring strategies with walk-forward evidence and comparable leaderboards.

source_groups.name: Research observability, experiment tracking and paper trading
source_groups.notes: Experiment tracking, data-version snapshots, paper-trading dashboards, approval workflows and automated performance reports turn strategy ideas into an auditable research pipeline.

source_groups.name: Seasonality, holiday and behavioral-calendar effects
source_groups.notes: Monthly seasonality, holiday windows, options-expiration windows and behavioral calendar effects are weak signals. They are best used as execution timing overlays or decay-audited filters.

source_groups.name: Crypto and alternative-market strategy transfer checks
source_groups.notes: Crypto sources provide funding-rate, regime-classification, exchange-risk and data-pipeline ideas. Most high-frequency or leveraged crypto strategies are not transferable to the current retail stock/ETF workflow.

source_groups.name: Factor engineering, labels and leakage-safe datasets
source_groups.notes: Factor libraries, labels and leakage-safe dataset preparation are prerequisites for any ML or multi-factor strategy. Point-in-time correctness, feature registry and factor decay monitoring matter more than adding hundreds of raw factors.

source_groups.name: Production monitoring, alerts and kill-switch workflows
source_groups.notes: Production trading systems emphasize alerts, logs, risk limits, kill switches, data-delay checks, paper/live monitoring and audit history. These are transferable to CodeYun's manual and paper-trading workflow.

source_groups.name: Market rules, tradability and execution constraints
source_groups.notes: Market-rule realism includes limit-up/down blocking, suspension, T+1/T+0 constraints, Stock Connect eligibility, board lots, tick sizes, stamp duties and fees. These constraints often decide whether a backtest is executable.

source_groups.name: Policy, macro calendar and event-risk workflows
source_groups.notes: Macro calendar, FOMC/CPI/NFP, earnings, geopolitical and regulatory-event workflows are most useful as risk labels and event windows. Treat them as filters or position-sizing overlays before treating them as standalone alpha.

source_groups.name: Strategy lifecycle, confidence testing and paper-trading platforms
source_groups.notes: Lifecycle platforms emphasize walk-forward validation, MLflow-style experiment tracking, run hashes, bootstrap/Monte-Carlo confidence tests, paper trading, realistic fills, TCA and promotion from research to monitoring.

source_groups.name: Fund, ETF, LOF and QDII microstructure/arbitrage sources
source_groups.notes: LOF/QDII/ETF premium-discount, creation-redemption status, IOPV/NAV delay, liquidity and fund-flow ideas are useful for execution guards and watchlists. Personal accounts often cannot perform full primary/secondary arbitrage, so classify these as monitor/filter first.

source_groups.name: Futures curve, basis, roll yield and CTA research
source_groups.notes: Futures research contributes trend-following, carry/roll-yield, basis, contract rolling and curve-quality ideas. For the current retail workflow, use them mainly as ETF/fund risk proxies unless futures trading permissions and data quality are explicitly handled.

source_groups.name: NLP, financial news, filings and sentiment research
source_groups.notes: NLP and sentiment projects provide ideas for headline classification, filings/call transcript analysis, LLM summaries and risk-event extraction. For CodeYun, treat these first as auditable event labels and review summaries, not autonomous trading signals.

source_groups.name: Corporate actions, buybacks, dividends and event-driven research
source_groups.notes: Corporate-action research covers dividends, buybacks, insider/holder changes, lockup releases, rights issues, merger events and adjustment-quality checks. For retail long-only workflows, prioritize ex-date adjustment, event risk and watchlists over hard arbitrage assumptions.

source_groups.name: Options income, wheel, spreads and protection research
source_groups.notes: Options income and protection projects cover covered calls, wheel strategies, spreads, iron condors, collars, protective puts, Greeks, assignment and margin. Keep these as research sandboxes until option-chain quality, permissions and risk limits are proven.

source_groups.name: Account, broker, cash, FX and execution constraint sources
source_groups.notes: Broker-aware research highlights fee/tax models, minimum commissions, cost basis, cash ledgers, multi-currency conversion, margin/account permissions, pre-trade risk checks, order-type support and broker calendar constraints.

source_groups.name: Portfolio allocation, rebalancing and risk budget research
source_groups.notes: Portfolio-level research emphasizes weight-centric execution, risk parity, constrained allocation, volatility targeting, drift-threshold rebalancing, regime-aware allocation, strategy ensembles, tracking error and concentration control.

source_groups.name: Market microstructure, auction, price-limit and execution research
source_groups.notes: Microstructure sources highlight official auction windows, price limits, order-book imbalance, queue position, latency, VWAP/TWAP parent orders, market impact, slippage and realistic fill simulation.

source_groups.name: Pairs trading, cointegration and statistical arbitrage research
source_groups.notes: Stat-arb research covers Engle-Granger cointegration, distance pairs, rolling OLS/Kalman hedge ratios, OU half-life, clustering-based pair discovery, Johansen baskets, residual reversal and strict transaction-cost/liquidity validation.

source_groups.name: Cross-sectional ML factor ranking and walk-forward research
source_groups.notes: Cross-sectional ML research is useful when framed as point-in-time feature pipelines, rolling train/predict splits, rank IC evaluation, LightGBM/linear/tree ensembles, feature stability, drift monitoring and cost-aware portfolio construction rather than autonomous black-box trading.

source_groups.name: Crypto perpetual funding, basis and cash-and-carry research
source_groups.notes: Crypto funding and basis research covers delta-neutral spot/perp positions, cross-exchange funding divergence, cash-and-carry, borrow/funding costs, liquidation risk, exchange custody risk, slippage, outage risk and funding timestamp alignment. Keep it isolated from HK/CN equity strategy recommendations.

source_groups.name: Volatility, VIX, variance risk premium and tail-risk research
source_groups.notes: Volatility research covers implied-vs-realized volatility, VIX and VIX term-structure proxies, realized-volatility forecasts, volatility targeting, tail hedging, VIX call hedges, option data quality, bid/ask/slippage, risk limits and the danger of blindly harvesting VRP.

source_groups.name: Calendar seasonality, holiday and rebalance-window research
source_groups.notes: Calendar research covers turn-of-month, pre-holiday, Sell-in-May/Halloween, option-expiration windows, ETF/index rebalance windows and style spread month-end effects. Treat these as weak overlays requiring market-specific validation, cost controls and out-of-sample decay checks.

source_groups.name: Fundamental value, quality, income and accounting-factor research
source_groups.notes: Fundamental research covers value, quality, profitability, dividend growth, Piotroski F-score, Magic Formula, accounting-risk scores, factor IC/turnover and survivorship-bias-free universe construction. Treat report release dates and restatements as hard data-quality requirements.

source_groups.name: Capital flow, ownership, institutional positioning and crowding research
source_groups.notes: Flow and ownership research covers institutional holdings, fund net buying, 13F-style position changes, northbound/southbound flows, margin financing, short interest, insider/seat activity and crowding. Use as slow confirmation or risk labels because disclosure delays and survivorship bias are material.

source_groups.name: Sector, theme, industry-chain and relative-rotation research
source_groups.notes: Sector and theme research covers relative rotation graphs, RS-Ratio/RS-Momentum, sector ETF momentum, theme ETF flows, industry breadth, lead-lag diffusion, concept crowding and benchmark-relative performance. Use sector/theme tags as portfolio constraints and overlays, not just standalone rankings.

source_groups.name: Rates, bond ETF, credit spread and duration rotation research
source_groups.notes: Rates and bond research covers Treasury/Bond ETF duration momentum, yield-curve slope and level changes, credit spread risk-off filters, stock-bond relative value, defensive allocation and interest-rate shock stress tests. For retail workflows, map most ideas to liquid bond ETFs or macro risk labels.

source_groups.name: FX, currency carry, USD/CNH and cross-border currency-risk research
source_groups.notes: FX research covers currency carry, currency momentum, USD trend risk proxies, USD/CNH and HKD/CNY settlement effects, multi-currency backtesting, exchange-rate attribution, cross-border ETF currency exposure and hedging-cost-aware portfolio accounting.

source_groups.name: Alternative data: search trends, web traffic, jobs, satellite and supply-chain research
source_groups.notes: Alternative-data research covers search trends, web traffic, app usage, job postings, satellite/geospatial signals, online prices, social attention, supply-chain proxies and news-derived event tags. These require strict timestamping, source stability, coverage tracking and out-of-sample decay monitoring.

source_groups.name: Trading journal, behavioral bias, risk discipline and execution-review research
source_groups.notes: Trading-journal research highlights plan-vs-actual logging, behavioral pattern detection, revenge trading, overconfidence, rule breaks, stop-loss/take-profit audits, position sizing, human approval, local-first privacy and structured post-trade reviews.

source_groups.name: Tax, fees, margin, borrow cost and net-return accounting research
source_groups.notes: Net-return research covers tax lots, cost basis, dividends, stamp duties, minimum commissions, broker fee schedules, maker/taker fees, margin interest, borrow fees, cash interest, transaction-cost sensitivity, TCA and portfolio accounting that matches real account statements.

source_groups.name: Data infrastructure, stale-cache fallback, artifact store and reproducible research
source_groups.notes: Infrastructure research highlights local caches, stale fallback, data-source health, ETL validation, data contracts, run artifacts, reproducible backtests, incremental updates, scheduled scans, paper-trade dashboards and controlled strategy mutation loops.

source_groups.name: Dynamic strategy selection, online portfolio selection and bandit allocation research
source_groups.notes: Dynamic selection research covers multi-armed bandits, Thompson sampling, online portfolio selection, meta-controllers, strategy fleets, DRL allocation, weighted voting, conflict resolution, cost-aware exploration and paper-trade-only promotion gates.

source_groups.name: Portfolio stress testing, scenario analysis and trading-system disaster recovery
source_groups.notes: Stress-testing research covers historical crisis replay, VaR/CVaR, Monte Carlo paths, factor shocks, liquidity freezes, correlation breakdown, sector concentration, DXY/rate shocks, drawdown recovery and operational disaster drills for data, broker and scheduled-job failures.

source_groups.name: Market breadth thrust, participation and relative strength research
source_groups.notes: Breadth research covers advance/decline thrust, percentage above moving averages, new high/new low expansion, StockBee-style market monitor signals, IBD-style relative strength percentile ranks, industry group leadership and RRG relative rotation. These ideas fit current daily OHLCV pools better than intraday-only strategies.

source_groups.name: Liquidity, volume anomaly and turnover factor research
source_groups.notes: Use amount, volume, turnover, price impact and liquidity shocks both as tradable factors and as hard filters for whether a signal can survive real execution.

strategies.notes: 对港股池尤其关键。

strategies.title: 北向持仓变化质量过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 北向持仓连续增减可作为中期资金偏好的确认信号，但更适合过滤质量/趋势候选，不应单独买入。

rules.feature: 北向持股比例变化、连续净增持天数、净增持市值、行业分布
rules.filter: 价格动量为正且北向持仓同步上升时加权；价格强但北向撤离时降权
rules.risk: 北向数据口径、披露延迟和大盘风格变化会造成假信号

validation_plan: 先验证对A股/港股代理动量策略的过滤效果
按行业/市值分层
年度拆分看稳定性
strategies.notes: 比主力资金口径更透明，值得后续数据补齐。

strategies.title: 融资余额拥挤风险过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 融资余额快速上升叠加价格高位可能代表杠杆拥挤，遇波动放大时下跌更剧烈。

rules.feature: 融资余额/流通市值、融资余额变化率、融券余额、价格位置
rules.filter: 高位且融资拥挤急升时降低买入优先级或缩小仓位
rules.risk: 融资活跃也可能代表强趋势，不能简单反向

validation_plan: 先做融资拥挤分位数与未来回撤关系
再接入股票池风险过滤
检查是否减少大亏交易
strategies.notes: 适合作为A股风险标签。

strategies.title: 龙虎榜事件延续/反转研究
strategies.hypothesis: 龙虎榜席位、净买入结构和成交占比可能对应短期延续或隔日反转，但噪声和操纵风险高。

rules.event: 龙虎榜上榜原因、机构/游资席位、净买入金额、成交占比
rules.study: 事件后1/3/5/10日超额收益和回撤
rules.filter: 只作为短线事件研究，不直接进入低频实盘候选
rules.risk: 样本选择和幸存者偏差强，事件拥挤且冲击成本高

validation_plan: 先做纯事件统计
按上榜原因/席位分层
若不稳定则保留为风险标签
strategies.notes: 创意价值高，但近期不适合实盘。

strategies.title: 筹码集中度突破过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 筹码集中区上沿突破且成本分布收敛时，突破信号可能更可靠；但筹码数据多为估算，需谨慎。

rules.feature: 筹码集中度、平均成本、获利盘比例、压力位/支撑位
rules.filter: 量能突破同时突破筹码密集区时加权，否则降权
rules.risk: 筹码算法黑箱，不能作为核心alpha

existing_mapping.planned_backend: research only unless data source stable

validation_plan: 先对有稳定筹码数据的A股样本做分层
比较有/无筹码过滤的突破策略
若数据口径不稳定则停留在研究
strategies.notes: 记录创意，不优先工程化。

strategies.title: 股指期货基差风险代理过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 股指期货贴水/升水和基差变化可反映套保压力与风险偏好，能作为指数ETF/港股风险开关代理。

rules.feature: 近月/远月基差、年化基差、期限结构变化、成交持仓
rules.filter: 深度贴水扩大且指数趋势转弱时降低权益ETF仓位
rules.risk: 基差受分红、交割、监管和对冲需求影响，不能单独择时

validation_plan: 先用沪深300/中证500/恒指代理做风险开关统计
与市场宽度/VIX代理组合
年度拆分看回撤过滤效果
strategies.notes: 适合作为慢速风险代理。

strategies.title: 基金重仓共识拥挤过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 公募基金重仓共识可代表机构认可，也可能代表拥挤交易；结合价格位置和持仓变化可作为质量/拥挤双向过滤。

rules.feature: 基金持仓家数、持仓市值占流通盘、季度增减持、行业集中度
rules.use: 低估/趋势候选中，适度机构共识加权；极端拥挤且价格高位降权
rules.risk: 基金季报滞后明显，不适合短线入场

validation_plan: 先按季度做持仓共识分层收益
再与质量/动量策略组合
检查滞后披露的可见性
strategies.notes: 更适合中期质量过滤，不适合日内/隔日交易。

strategies.title: 货币 Carry/Momentum 代理 ETF 配置
strategies.hypothesis: 高利差货币和货币动量在全球宏观中常见，但国内可交易代理有限，当前更适合作为跨资产TAA研究。

rules.features: 利差、汇率中期动量、美元指数趋势、人民币汇率压力
rules.allocation: 作为全球宏观风险状态和跨境ETF汇率风险标签
rules.risk: 汇率交易工具可得性、资本管制和对冲成本限制明显

validation_plan: 先只做US_proxy和跨境ETF汇率敏感性研究
不进入近期实盘候选
作为跨境ETF风险标签
strategies.notes: 记录为宏观代理，不直接做外汇交易。

strategies.title: 商品期限结构 Carry 轮动
strategies.hypothesis: 商品期货贴水/升水反映滚动收益，和价格动量结合可能优于单纯商品ETF动量。

rules.features: 近远月价差、年化roll yield、价格动量、波动率
rules.select: 只选择动量为正且carry不显著负的商品ETF/基金代理
rules.risk: 国内商品ETF往往不直接等同持有期货，期限结构数据可能缺失

existing_mapping.planned_backend: commodity carry feature when data exists

validation_plan: 先用US_proxy验证carry+momentum
再检查国内商品ETF是否有可靠代理
与黄金ETF趋势策略对比
strategies.notes: 可作为跨资产ETF池增强项。

strategies.title: 债券久期动量/收益率曲线轮动
strategies.hypothesis: 短债/中债/长债ETF的相对动量与收益率曲线状态可决定防守资产久期暴露。

rules.universe: 短久期、中久期、长久期债券ETF或代理
rules.features: 债券ETF动量、收益率曲线斜率、利率波动、回撤
rules.select: 权益风险关闭时，在不同久期债券ETF和现金之间轮动
rules.risk: 利率急升时长债和权益可能同跌

validation_plan: 把扩展防守池接入正式ETF轮动回测参数
每日复盘里展示防守腿选择理由和目标资产
继续校验长债短样本偏差、ETF费率、流动性和溢价约束
strategies.notes: 2026-06-14本地探针显示，扩展到政金债、城投债、地方债和货币ETF后，canary/HAA防守腿表现明显优于只用黄金/国债ETF的旧池。当前不作为独立收益策略承诺，优先作为跨资产ETF轮动的防守腿增强。

strategies.title: 股债相对价值风险开关
strategies.hypothesis: 股息/盈利收益率相对债券收益率的变化，可作为权益风险溢价和股债切换的慢变量。

rules.features: 指数盈利收益率、股息率、10年国债收益率、信用利差
rules.filter: 权益风险溢价偏低且趋势转弱时降低权益仓位
rules.combine: 与价格动量、市场宽度和波动率过滤共同使用
rules.risk: 估值变量慢，可能长期失效，不适合短线择时

validation_plan: 先做月频风险开关研究
和纯动量ETF轮动对比
观察熊市和震荡市过滤效果
strategies.notes: 更适合组合层，不用于明日开盘信号。

strategies.title: 全球宏观 ETF TAA 多资产池
strategies.hypothesis: 权益、债券、商品、黄金、美元/现金代理组成的宏观ETF池，可用动量、波动和相关性做低频TAA。

rules.universe: 权益、债券、黄金、商品、REITs、美元/现金代理
rules.rank: 12/6/3月动量 + 波动惩罚 + 相关性分散
rules.risk: 国内可交易ETF映射不完整，跨境ETF折溢价和汇率暴露明显

validation_plan: 先用US_proxy建立基准
再映射国内可交易ETF池
年度对比沪深300/恒生/现金
strategies.notes: 适合作为跨资产ETF策略的中期升级。

strategies.title: 已证伪策略负样本档案
strategies.hypothesis: 研究库不仅要保存候选策略，也要保存被证伪或复现失败的策略，避免反复调参追逐假信号。

rules.record: 失败假设、数据区间、参数、复现结果、失败原因、不可再尝试条件
rules.classify: 逻辑错误、数据泄漏、成本吞噬、样本外失效、不可执行
rules.reuse: 新策略若与负样本高度相似，必须说明差异和新证据
rules.risk: 不记录负结果会让研究循环浪费大量时间

validation_plan: 先把已搜索但失败的港股池参数记录为负样本
后续每次搜索自动保存失败摘要
页面上显示类似策略警告
strategies.notes: 这是研究质量治理，不是交易信号。

strategies.title: 多策略等风险预算组合
strategies.hypothesis: 通过把 ETF轮动、港股池、可转债、防守资产等策略按风险预算组合，可能比押注单一策略更稳定。

rules.inputs: 每个策略的净值曲线、回撤、波动、相关性、容量和可执行性评分
rules.weighting: 等权、等风险贡献、波动率倒数或最大权重约束
rules.rebalance: 月频/季频调整策略权重，避免频繁追逐短期表现
rules.risk: 策略收益流本身可能共用相同数据和风险源，相关性在危机中上升

validation_plan: 先把ETF/港股/可转债候选作为策略收益流
比较单策略与组合年度表现
检查危机期相关性上升
strategies.notes: 当候选足够多后，这是比继续新增信号更重要的方向。

strategies.title: 策略动量轮动选择器
strategies.hypothesis: 不同策略存在表现周期，选择近期样本外表现较强且回撤可控的策略组合，可能提高资金效率。

rules.rank: 按近3/6/12个月样本外收益、回撤恢复和波动调整收益排序
rules.select: TopN策略获得权重，其余降为观察
rules.guard: 策略动量必须通过成本和过拟合审计，避免追涨杀跌
rules.risk: 策略收益自相关不稳定，容易过度追逐最近表现

validation_plan: 先只在历史策略收益流上模拟
与固定等权策略组合比较
观察换手和最差年份
strategies.notes: 研究价值高，但需严格防止二层过拟合。

strategies.title: 策略相关性去重闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 许多看似不同的策略其实暴露在同一动量/风险开关上，必须按收益相关性和持仓重叠去重。

rules.measure: 策略收益相关性、最大回撤重叠、持仓重叠、交易日重叠
rules.gate: 高度相似策略只保留更稳健、更简单、成本更低的一条
rules.report: 为每个新候选显示最相似的已知策略和差异
rules.risk: 低相关历史可能在危机中失效，需做压力窗口相关性

validation_plan: 先对现有ETF/港股搜索结果聚类
标记重复策略族
减少leaderboard重复候选

strategies.title: CPCV/Purged Walk-forward 验证闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 普通年度拆分仍可能泄漏相邻样本信息，CPCV和purged walk-forward可更严格评估参数搜索结果。

rules.split: 按时间块组合训练/验证，并对相邻窗口做purge/embargo
rules.score: 关注验证集分布、最差分位收益、失败窗口比例

strategies.notes: 适合防止策略研究进入二层过拟合。

strategies.title: 策略排行榜晋级/退役制度
strategies.hypothesis: 研究库需要统一排行榜和晋级/退役规则，避免页面首屏长期堆积未经验证或已经失效的策略。

rules.promotion: 必须通过年度、成本、执行、相关性和样本外验证
rules.retirement: 样本外连续失效、数据不可得、成本吞噬或负样本相似时退役
rules.report: 每个策略展示当前tier、最近证据、下一步验证动作

validation_plan: 先给当前101条策略生成tier草案

strategies.title: 策略实验追踪与制品库
strategies.hypothesis: 每次回测/搜索都应保存参数、代码版本、数据版本、结果和图表制品，否则结果不可复现。

rules.record: run_id、strategy_id、参数、数据范围、代码版本、数据版本、开始/结束时间
rules.artifacts: 年度收益表、交易日志、净值曲线、成本曲线、验证报告
rules.compare: 同一策略不同参数和不同数据版本可并排比较
rules.risk: 没有实验追踪，后续无法判断一个结论来自哪次数据和代码

validation_plan: 先定义run metadata schema
把现有港股/ETF回测快照接入run_id
页面按run比较结果
strategies.notes: 这是所有后续研究可复现性的基础设施。

strategies.title: 纸面交易影子组合监控
strategies.hypothesis: 通过影子组合每天记录策略信号、计划订单、实际可执行价和假想持仓，能在实盘前发现执行和数据问题。

rules.daily: 收盘后生成明日计划，次日记录开盘/成交代理价、跳过原因和持仓变化
rules.compare: 比较回测假设收益、纸面执行收益和基准收益

strategies.title: 每日策略复盘报告生成器
strategies.hypothesis: 每天收盘后即使无交易，也应记录市场状态、策略状态、触发/未触发原因和明日动作，形成连续证据链。

rules.sections: 市场状态、候选策略、风险过滤、明日计划、无策略原因、数据缺口
rules.output: 写入robot-history页面可读快照，保留历史版本
rules.no_signal: 无策略时仍总结原因和下一步观察

validation_plan: 先对ETF/港股通策略生成日报schema

strategies.title: 行情数据版本快照闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 行情、成分、财务、事件数据会修订；回测必须记录使用的数据版本和更新时间，才能复现实验。

rules.snapshot: 记录数据源、缓存文件、更新时间、覆盖区间、缺失数量和修订标记
rules.gate: 关键数据缺失或版本变化时，旧回测标记为需重算
rules.report: 策略结果展示对应数据版本，避免新旧缓存混用
rules.risk: 数据修订会让同一参数跑出不同结果

validation_plan: 先为ETF/港股K线和策略池缓存记录版本
回测结果引用数据快照id

strategies.title: 人工批准的盘前检查清单
strategies.hypothesis: 在真实下单前，系统应把信号、风险、价格跳过条件、资金占用和异常数据整理成可人工确认的检查清单。

rules.checklist: 策略tier、今日信号、建议仓位、跳过价、数据状态、风险过滤、成本估计
rules.approve: 用户明确确认后才视为可执行；默认不自动下单

validation_plan: 先在页面展示只读检查清单

strategies.title: 绩效归因与误差预算报告

rules.attribution: 按资产、行业、策略、交易、成本、现金拖累分解收益
rules.error_budget: 记录滑点、现金拖累、延迟执行和数据缺失对收益的影响

strategies.title: 月度季节性衰减审计过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 部分资产存在月份收益差异，但日历效应容易衰减，应先作为弱过滤器并持续审计稳定性。

rules.feature: 过去N年同月平均收益、胜率、波动和最近衰减程度
rules.use: 只在主策略信号相同强度时微调优先级，不单独买入

strategies.notes: 港股通主策略必须补齐的可信度前置。2026-06-14 数据源探针：AKShare 南向持股接口可取 2026-06-12 的610只股票快照，2024下半年至2026有部分交易日可用，但2024上半年和2023以前样本未能取到；它只能作为近期保守代理，不能替代完整历史港股通可买名单。用该代理池复测FIP/动量后收益显著恶化，说明历史资格闸门是硬性前置，而不是可后补的执行细节。

strategies.title: 最小价位/每手股数舍入闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 港股每手股数和价位表、A股/ETF最小价格单位会影响10万元账户的可买数量和跳过价设置。

rules.price: 按交易所tick size舍入限价、跳过价和止损价
rules.quantity: 按board lot/最小交易单位舍入数量
rules.cash: 舍入后重新计算资金占用和现金拖累
rules.risk: 不做舍入会生成不可下单的计划

validation_plan: 先对港股通和ETF订单计划应用舍入
比较舍入前后资金占用
阻断不可下单计划
strategies.notes: 直接影响页面给出的下单数量。

strategies.title: 印花税/交易费/税费模型闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 不同市场和品种税费差异显著，港股印花税/交易费和A股卖出印花税会改变短线净收益。

rules.fees: 佣金、印花税、交易征费、交易费、平台费、过户费、最低佣金
rules.instrument: 按股票/ETF/可转债/港股通分别建模
rules.gate: 未配置费用模型时，短线策略结果标记为不可晋级
rules.risk: 高换手策略对费用极敏感

validation_plan: 先定义CN/HK/ETF/可转债费用模板
回放高换手策略净收益
在日报展示预估成本
strategies.notes: 短线收益是否可观必须扣除真实费用。

strategies.title: 高影响宏观日历跳过过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: FOMC、CPI、NFP、央行议息和高影响经济数据发布日前后，短线信号容易受跳空和波动率冲击，应减少新开仓或降低仓位。

rules.event_window: 高影响事件前1个交易日到发布后1个交易日标记为风险窗口
rules.scope: 按资产映射区分美股代理、港股风险资产、黄金/原油/债券代理和加密资产
rules.action: 风险窗口内禁止追涨型新开仓，或将计划仓位降为半仓/观察仓
rules.risk: 宏观事件不是方向预测，不能把事件标签当成确定性多空信号

validation_plan: 先手工维护FOMC/CPI/NFP和主要央行事件表
回放ETF轮动和港股通策略在事件日前后的表现
比较跳过/半仓/不处理三种规则
strategies.notes: 优先接入每日复盘，不作为独立买卖策略。

strategies.title: 政策/监管行业事件风险过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: 平台经济、教育、地产、医药集采、游戏版号、金融监管等政策事件会改变行业风险溢价，短线动量策略应在事件窗口内限制受影响行业。

rules.tagging: 将政策新闻、监管公告和行业事件映射到行业/主题标签
rules.window: 重大负面政策后若趋势未重新确认，暂停新开仓受影响行业3-10个交易日
rules.positive: 正面政策只允许解除风险过滤，不直接触发追涨买入
rules.risk: 政策文本解读主观性强，必须保留人工复核和事件来源

validation_plan: 先建立人工事件登记表
回放港股科技/地产/医药等典型政策窗口
统计过滤对回撤和错失收益的影响
strategies.notes: 适合作为人工复盘输入，不能完全自动化解释政策方向。

strategies.title: 财报/业绩预告黑窗与跳空风险过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: 财报、业绩预告、盈警和业绩会前后跳空风险上升；没有事件 alpha 证明时，短线策略应避免在黑窗内新开仓个股。

rules.blackout: 财报/业绩预告/盈警前后若干交易日禁止新开仓或降低仓位
rules.exception: 只有PEAD/盈喜后漂移策略通过独立验证时才允许事件后入场
rules.etf: 宽基ETF不因单个成分财报阻断，行业ETF按权重集中度决定
rules.risk: 财报日期、预告日期和实际发布时间必须区分，否则会产生前视偏差

validation_plan: 先采集港股盈警/财报日期和A股业绩预告
按公告前后窗口统计跳空分布
接入每日开仓清单过滤
strategies.notes: 与PEAD研究互补：未证明alpha前先按风险黑窗处理。

strategies.title: 地缘冲击/商品避险事件覆盖层
strategies.hypothesis: 地缘冲突、能源供给冲击和避险情绪会影响黄金、原油、军工和风险资产，但更适合作为情景覆盖层而非机械预测信号。

rules.event_label: 将地缘/能源冲击标记为风险资产降仓、黄金/原油观察或禁止追高三类状态
rules.confirmation: 只有价格趋势和成交量确认后才允许进入商品代理
rules.decay: 事件标签必须设置过期时间，避免长期污染策略状态
rules.risk: 新闻冲击极易反转，且商品ETF存在溢价、汇率和跟踪误差

validation_plan: 先手工标记近年典型地缘/能源冲击窗口
测试黄金/原油ETF趋势确认规则
统计事件覆盖层是否降低组合回撤
strategies.notes: 只放低优先级研究，避免把新闻交易当确定性策略。

strategies.title: 央行流动性状态切换过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: 降准、降息、MLF/OMO投放、美元利率和港元流动性会改变风险资产环境，适合作为慢速仓位上限或现金/债券切换条件。

rules.state: 宽松、中性、收紧三档流动性状态
rules.inputs: 国内政策利率/资金利率、美元利率、港元拆息和主要央行路径
rules.action: 收紧状态降低高beta策略仓位上限，宽松状态只解除限制不直接买入
rules.risk: 宏观变量低频且滞后，不能用于日内精确择时

validation_plan: 先用月频/周频数据构造状态
叠加到ETF轮动和港股通策略
比较仓位上限对年度收益和回撤的影响
strategies.notes: 比事件日历慢，更适合组合层风险预算。

strategies.title: 事件日历数据质量闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 宏观、政策、财报和监管事件只有在时间戳、时区、发布日期和市场映射可靠时才可进入回测或每日信号。

rules.timestamp: 区分预定时间、实际发布时间、交易时段内/外和本地时区
rules.revision: 记录数据修订、延迟录入和人工修改历史
rules.mapping: 事件必须映射到受影响市场/行业/标的和有效期
rules.gate: 缺少时间戳或来源的事件只可展示给人工参考，不可自动阻断交易

validation_plan: 先定义事件表schema
对FOMC/CPI/财报/盈警各做样例
未通过质量闸门的事件不得进入自动回测
strategies.notes: 这是使用任何事件过滤器之前的前置工程。

strategies.title: 策略运行哈希与可复现性闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 每次回测和每日复盘必须记录策略版本、参数、数据快照、代码哈希和运行环境，否则后续无法解释收益差异或复现结果。

rules.artifacts: 保存输入参数、候选池、信号快照、交易列表、权益曲线、日志摘要和错误状态
rules.immutability: 已生成的研究结果只追加新版本，不覆盖旧版本
rules.risk: 没有运行身份的漂亮回测不得进入leaderboard

validation_plan: 先为港股池搜索和ETF轮动回测生成run_id
保存参数/数据版本/摘要指标
让leaderboard只读取有完整run元数据的结果
strategies.notes: 这是把研究库从文本清单变成可复现实验库的基础。

strategies.title: 策略边际置信度 Bootstrap/Monte Carlo 闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 收益、Sharpe或胜率本身不足以证明策略有效；需要用bootstrap置信区间、交易顺序重排和蒙特卡洛连亏压力测试检查是否只是噪声。

rules.bootstrap: 对交易收益和日收益做重采样，输出年化收益、Sharpe、最大回撤和亏损持续时间区间
rules.monte_carlo: 随机重排交易顺序和滑点扰动，估计最坏连续亏损和资金曲线分布
rules.promotion: 置信区间下沿仍满足底线，才允许进入纸面交易
rules.risk: 样本少或收益集中时，置信度结果应降级而不是给出确定结论

validation_plan: 先对现有港股Top2和ETF轮动生成bootstrap报告
输出置信区间和蒙特卡洛最大回撤
把结果接入晋级/退役制度
strategies.notes: 比单点收益更接近“这个优势是否真实”。

strategies.title: 纸面交易 Dry-run 成交质量监控
strategies.hypothesis: 策略从回测进入真实执行前，必须先用纸面订单监控开盘价、成交量、滑点、跳过价和可成交性差异。

rules.dry_run: 每日生成订单计划但不实盘下单，记录理论成交、保守成交和实际可见行情
rules.fill_quality: 比较计划价格、开盘价、最高最低、成交额、价差代理和最终跳过原因
rules.promotion: 连续若干周成交质量稳定后才允许小仓验证
rules.risk: 纸面交易也不能用未来收盘价替代实际执行价格

validation_plan: 先接入每日复盘订单计划
记录至少20个交易日的纸面成交差异
报告策略收益和执行误差拆分
strategies.notes: 直接服务手动交易，优先级高于增加新信号。

strategies.title: 策略 TCA 执行误差归因
strategies.hypothesis: 策略实盘或纸面收益偏离回测时，需要拆分为信号收益、价格滑点、税费、现金拖累、未成交和人工跳过造成的差异。

rules.benchmark: 每笔订单保留理论成交价、计划限价、实际/纸面成交价和收盘参考价
rules.decompose: 归因到信号alpha、开盘跳空、滑点、费用、数量舍入、未成交、人工调整
rules.report: 月度报告展示最大误差来源和需要修正的执行规则
rules.risk: 没有TCA时，策略失败可能被误判为alpha失效或人工失误

validation_plan: 先对纸面交易产生TCA字段
按策略和标的聚合执行误差
用TCA反馈跳过价和滑点模型
strategies.notes: 让每日复盘能回答为什么实盘和回测不同。

strategies.title: 策略组合回撤分散度闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 多个策略组合前，不只看收益相关性，还要看回撤是否同向、亏损月份是否重叠和风险预算是否真正分散。

rules.metrics: 策略收益相关、回撤相关、亏损月份重叠率、尾部损失共振、资金占用冲突
rules.gate: 同源/同亏损窗口策略只能保留一个主策略或降低权重
rules.allocation: 按风险预算而不是名义资金等权组合
rules.risk: 收益低相关但尾部同跌的组合会在关键时刻失效

validation_plan: 先用ETF轮动、港股通、可转债候选的日收益流测试
输出回撤重叠矩阵
再决定是否能进入组合层
strategies.notes: 用于避免把同一个市场beta包装成多个策略。

strategies.title: Champion/Challenger 纸面晋级工作流
strategies.hypothesis: 策略上线应采用Champion/Challenger机制：当前主策略继续运行，新策略先纸面竞争，达到稳定性和执行质量门槛后再替换或加入小仓。

rules.promotion: 晋级需满足样本外收益、回撤、执行质量、相关性去重和人工批准
rules.retirement: 连续失效、数据源不可靠或执行误差过大时退役
rules.risk: 频繁更换冠军策略会形成元层过拟合

validation_plan: 先给现有港股通/ETF/可转债方向标记角色
定义晋级阈值和最短观察期
在每日复盘页面展示champion/challenger状态
strategies.notes: 这是把大量策略候选变成可管理队列的关键流程。

strategies.title: LOF 折溢价套利观察清单
strategies.hypothesis: LOF 二级市场价格相对净值出现较大折溢价时，可能存在折价买入或溢价卖出/申赎套利机会，但个人账户受到账户权限、份额到账、申赎费率和流动性限制。

rules.screen: 成交额达到阈值且折价率/溢价率超过历史分位或固定阈值时进入观察
rules.direction: 折价只作为买入折扣观察，溢价只作为卖出/避买警示，默认不假设能完成申赎套利
rules.cost: 计入申购费、赎回费、交易佣金、到账日和净值波动
rules.risk: 净值滞后、持仓停牌、流动性不足和套利拥挤会让折溢价长期存在

validation_plan: 先用AKShare基金数据生成LOF折溢价榜
回放高折价买入后1/5/20日表现
区分可申赎和只适合二级市场观察的标的
strategies.notes: 先做观察清单，不直接给套利交易建议。

strategies.title: QDII/跨境 ETF 溢价与额度风险过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: QDII和跨境ETF常因外盘休市、申购额度、汇率和时差出现持续高溢价；趋势信号正确时，高溢价买入仍可能被净值回归吞噬。

rules.block: 买入时溢价率高于阈值或历史高分位，阻断新开仓
rules.warning: 外盘休市、暂停申购、额度紧张和汇率剧烈波动时提高风险等级
rules.allow: 折价或低溢价只解除阻断，不自动构成买入信号
rules.risk: 估算净值和实时IOPV可能滞后，不能当作精确套利价格

validation_plan: 先覆盖日经/纳指/标普/港股/商品跨境ETF
统计高溢价买入后的折溢价回归损失
接入ETF轮动下单前跳过价
strategies.notes: 这是跨资产ETF轮动的高优先级执行约束。

strategies.title: ETF IOPV/NAV 延迟质量闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 折溢价策略和执行保护依赖 IOPV/NAV；若净值时间戳、估算口径、汇率或外盘价格滞后，折溢价信号会失真。

rules.timestamp: 记录价格、IOPV、官方NAV、汇率和外盘参考价的时间戳
rules.freshness: 超过新鲜度阈值的IOPV只能展示，不可用于自动阻断或回测
rules.source: 区分官方NAV、交易所IOPV、第三方估算净值和自算净值
rules.risk: 跨境/商品ETF的真实净值与盘中估算误差可能很大

validation_plan: 先在ETF折溢价榜展示时间戳和来源
缺时间戳时降级为人工参考
回测只使用point-in-time可见的净值数据
strategies.notes: 没有这个闸门，ETF折溢价回测很容易前视。

strategies.title: 封闭式/定开基金折价轮动
strategies.hypothesis: 封闭式或定开基金若存在可交易折价，折价收敛、分红和到期/开放期可能贡献收益；但流动性和持仓透明度限制较大。

rules.select: 折价率高、成交额合格、剩余封闭期明确、历史折价有均值回归特征
rules.exit: 折价收敛到阈值、临近开放期、流动性恶化或净值趋势转弱时退出
rules.income: 把分红、管理费、赎回安排和税费纳入总收益
rules.risk: 折价可能反映真实持仓质量问题，不一定会收敛

validation_plan: 先扫描可上市交易基金中有稳定NAV的标的
按折价分位做月频轮动
检查收益来自折价收敛还是净值beta
strategies.notes: 属于低频研究，不适合每日追涨。

strategies.title: ETF 申赎状态与流动性过滤器
strategies.hypothesis: ETF暂停申购/赎回、现金替代比例高、做市不足或成交额不足时，二级市场价格更容易偏离净值，执行风险应上调。

rules.status: 记录可申购、可赎回、暂停、限制额度、现金替代比例和最小申赎单位
rules.liquidity: 成交额、盘口价差代理和换手低于阈值时禁止新开仓
rules.premium: 申赎异常时降低折溢价信号可信度，并提高买入溢价阻断阈值敏感度
rules.risk: 个人账户无法直接参与申赎，也会受到机构套利状态影响

validation_plan: 先从ETF元数据补申赎/流动性字段
在ETF轮动候选中过滤异常状态
统计过滤后错失收益和减少回撤
strategies.notes: ETF策略可执行性的基础卫生检查。

strategies.title: 基金资金流 + 溢价拥挤反向过滤
strategies.hypothesis: 当热门主题ETF同时出现大额净流入、高成交拥挤和高溢价时，短线追涨风险上升；资金流应作为拥挤过滤而不是简单买入信号。

rules.crowding: 净流入、成交额放大、价格远离均线和高溢价同时出现时标记拥挤
rules.action: 拥挤状态下禁止追涨型新开仓，已有仓位可降低加仓优先级
rules.contrarian: 拥挤降温且趋势未破坏时才重新允许买入
rules.risk: 资金流数据可能滞后，且净流入也可能代表真实趋势启动

validation_plan: 先对热门行业/跨境ETF回放资金流和溢价组合
比较追涨阻断对回撤的影响
接入每日复盘风险提示
strategies.notes: 适合作为主题ETF风险提示，不单独决定买卖。

strategies.title: 国债期货基差/久期对冲代理
strategies.hypothesis: 国债期货基差、收益率曲线和久期动量可辅助判断防守资产应选现金、短债还是长债。

strategies.title: Kalman 动态对冲比例配对模型
strategies.hypothesis: 固定OLS对冲比例在关系漂移时容易失效，Kalman Filter 可动态估计 hedge ratio 并减少价差误判。

rules.state: 用Kalman Filter估计截距和对冲比例的时间变化

rules.guard: 状态方差扩大或参数跳变时暂停交易

strategies.title: OU 半衰期与价差质量闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 均值回归策略必须验证价差半衰期、残差平稳性和回归速度；半衰期过长或不稳定的配对应被过滤。

rules.half_life: 估计OU/AR(1)半衰期，并限制在可交易持有周期内
rules.quality: 检查残差平稳性、z-score分布、极端偏离和交易成本后的回归空间

strategies.title: 聚类同伴残差反转模型

rules.cluster: 用行业、风格因子、收益相关性或降维聚类构建同伴组

strategies.title: Johansen 篮子价差回归沙盒
strategies.hypothesis: 三只以上相关资产可能形成更稳定的协整篮子，但组合复杂度、交易成本和权重解释难度显著增加。

rules.basket: 用Johansen测试寻找多资产协整向量
rules.weights: 限制篮子权重、换手、做空需求和单边暴露
rules.sandbox: 只做研究记录和小样本验证，不进入每日建议

strategies.hypothesis: 用价格量能、波动率、动量、反转和流动性等点时间特征训练横截面排名模型，可能比单因子排序更稳定，但必须防止数据泄漏和幸存者偏差。

rules.features: 只使用预测日之前可得的滚动特征，特征窗口和标签窗口显式记录

strategies.notes: 适合作为研究流水线，不直接替代当前规则策略。

strategies.title: LightGBM 滚动训练股票排名器
strategies.hypothesis: LightGBM 能捕捉非线性特征交互，但在金融横截面上极易过拟合；只有滚动训练、样本外分位收益和成本后收益都稳定才可晋级。

rules.split: 严格按时间滚动训练/验证/测试，不使用随机切分
rules.model: 限制树深、叶子数和特征数量，保存每次训练参数和随机种子
rules.score: 用RankIC、Top分位收益、换手、成本后超额和年度稳定性评估
rules.risk: 模型收益集中在少数年份或高换手小票时直接降级

validation_plan: 先在离线快照中跑小规模LightGBM排名
输出每年RankIC均值/标准差和分位组合收益
和线性模型基线比较
strategies.notes: 先做研究候选，避免黑箱直接上日报。

strategies.title: RankIC 与特征稳定性监控
strategies.hypothesis: 因子和模型在上线后会衰减；持续监控RankIC、覆盖率、缺失率、分布漂移和分位收益能及时发现失效。

rules.drift: 监控特征分布、缺失率、极值、行业暴露和预测分数分布
rules.action: 连续低于阈值时降权、暂停或退役
rules.risk: 只看累计收益会延迟发现特征泄漏或模型失效

validation_plan: 先对已有因子和未来ML模型统一输出RankIC月报
定义暂停阈值
接入策略生命周期晋级/退役规则
strategies.notes: 这条比具体模型更优先。

strategies.title: 行业/市值中性化特征闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 很多看似有效的特征只是行业、市值、流动性或价格水平暴露；中性化和暴露归因能减少伪 alpha。

rules.neutralize: 对候选特征按行业、市值、流动性、beta做横截面中性化或分组检验
rules.compare: 同时保存原始特征和中性化特征的IC/收益差异
rules.exposure: 模型组合输出行业、市值、beta和流动性暴露
rules.risk: 中性化过度会抹掉真实风险溢价，必须保留对照

validation_plan: 先对动量、质量、低波和成交额因子做中性化对照

strategies.notes: 避免把行业轮动误认为选股模型。

strategies.title: 模型预测集成与权重融合策略
strategies.hypothesis: 线性模型、LightGBM、规则因子和事件过滤器的预测分数若低相关，简单集成可能比单模型更稳健。

rules.members: 每个成员模型必须有独立样本外预测、RankIC和分位收益记录
rules.blend: 用等权、IC加权、风险预算或退火权重融合预测分数
rules.guard: 成员模型相关性过高或同步失效时降低总权重
rules.risk: 用近期收益动态加权容易追逐噪声

validation_plan: 先把规则因子和ML预测统一成score

逐年检查收益来源是否分散
strategies.notes: 等多个模型都有稳定记录后再做。

strategies.title: ML 点时间特征库闸门
strategies.hypothesis: 机器学习策略最常见的虚假收益来自特征时间戳、复权、成分股和公告可见时间错误；必须先有点时间特征库闸门。

rules.timestamp: 每个特征记录as_of时间、计算窗口、数据源更新时间和可交易日对齐方式
rules.universe: 保存历史成分股、停牌、退市、新股和ST/风险警示状态
rules.audit: 训练集生成必须可复现，任何特征变更都记录版本
rules.risk: 没有点时间特征库时，ML回测结果默认不可晋级
